migrated_entries.reason: Baseline (input_native) analysis exposes deceleration and path metrics; these are the exact signals the control-smoothness entry explains, so Coach can now retrieve this entry when a baseline tracking analysis has no visual-pipeline metrics to query on.
Terminal control is deceleration control; adding the two deceleration-path baseline metrics lets the entry be retrieved from a baseline static analysis too, not only from exact-pipeline signals.
